description: This file defines the RecruitmentAttachmentDao class, which manages database operations related to recruitment attachments such as saving, retrieving, and deleting various attachment entities (vacancy, candidate, interview) in the OrangeHRM recruitment module.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing recruitment-related attachments, including CRUD operations for vacancy, candidate, and interview attachments, and specific query methods to retrieve attachment data based on various filters and user roles.

methods.name: saveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Persists a VacancyAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Persists a CandidateAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Persists an InterviewAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a VacancyAttachment by its ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing attachment IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: getPartialCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial RecruitmentAttachment object for a candidate by candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves the CandidateAttachment entity for a candidate.

methods.name: hasCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Checks if a candidate has any attachments.

methods.name: getPartialInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial RecruitmentAttachment object for an interview attachment filtered by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves an InterviewAttachment entity by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Fetches all attachments associated with a specific vacancy.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsCountByVacancyId
methods.description: Returns the count of attachments for a specific vacancy.

methods.name: deleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple vacancy attachments by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Deletes the candidate's attachment by candidate ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of interview attachments based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of interview attachments based on search filters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all interview attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all vacancy attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Returns IDs of attachments for vacancies associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Returns IDs of interview attachments associated with vacancies managed by a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns IDs of interview attachments accessible to an interviewer based on their interview assignments.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves interview IDs accessible to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getExistingInterviewAttachmentIdsForInterview
methods.description: Gets existing attachment IDs for a specific interview, filtered by a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Deletes interview attachments given their IDs and associated interview ID.
